newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CDW Int'l privatisation plan approved.
newsitem.headline: CDW Int'l privatisation plan approved.

text.p: CDW Holdings Ltd said on Monday its proposal to privatise its locally-listed unit CDW International Ltd has been approved by shareholders and the last date for dealing in the shares is expected to be April 21.
The proposal was also subject to the fulfilment of certain regulatory conditions of the Cayman Islands, the companies said in a joint statement.

Payments of HK$1.20 per share payable under the scheme would be made to the holders of the scheme shares whose names appeared on the register of members of CDW International at the close of business on April 29, they said.
CDW International earlier said CDW Holdings and parties acting in concert with it own 74.91 percent of the company's issued shares.
After the offering, CDW Holdings would request a withdrawal of the listing of CDW International shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, it said.
